for c in Tabs Switch Card Button TextInput Text Title Flex Checkbox Label Icon Container Header Link Action; do printf "%s: " $c; grep -l "export declare const $c\b\|export declare function $c\b\|export { $c\|export \* from" -r components/index.d.ts >/dev/null && grep -rn "\b$c\b" components/index.d.ts | head -1 || echo none; echo; done 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ----; cat components/navigation/Tabs/Tabs.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; find . -name "Tabs.d.ts" -o -name "Switch.d.ts" | grep -v cjs | head

cat components/index.d.ts | sed 's/export \* from "\.\///' | tr '\n' ' ' ; echo; echo ----; cat components/legacy/Tabs/Tabs.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; ls components/ | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,40p Button/Button.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "ButtonView\b" -A3 Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo ----; grep -n "export interface\|onUpdate\|onKeyDown\|value" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -12; echo ----; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|content" Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; echo ----; grep -n "direction\|gap\|alignItems\|justifyContent\|wrap" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -12; echo ----; grep -n "maxWidth\|size\|spacing" layout/Container/Container.d.ts | head -5

sleep 6; cat /tmp/vite.log | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5173/
